name: Stone Blows
text:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

---
You harden your skin into a powerful weapon. Make a melee unarmed Strike. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. If the Strike hits, it deals an additional 1d6 bludgeoning damage. This additional damage increases to 2d6 at 10th level and to 3d6 at 18th level.
